Surrounding this figure are other individuals, standing and dressed in formal attire typical of the period, with high ruffled collars and elaborate sleeves. To the left, a man in a doublet and breeches walks holding his hat, and to the right, a woman holds a fan delicately. All the people in the scene have styled hair appropriate to the time period—tightly arranged and sometimes accented with tiaras or other adornments. In addition to the clothing, multiple individuals wear necklaces or brooches. The background shows a detailed interior with architectural elements, including decorative molding and wall features, contributing to the regal or ceremonial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot after Andrea del Sarto
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting four figures in a circular composition. Each figure is shown from the waist up. In the center, two young children are seated and facing forward. The child on the left has curly hair, and the child on the right appears to be holding something. To the left and right of the children are two women who seem to be caregivers. The woman on the left is shown in profile wearing a head covering and a long-sleeved garment. She looks towards the other woman while holding the child. The woman on the right is slightly turned towards the viewer, also dressed in flowing garments and a head covering, and appears to hold the other child. Behind the woman on the left, an older man with a bearded face and serious expression looks over the group. He wears a head scarf and holds a staff. The background features a simple engraved texture, and the scene is enclosed within a circular frame. Below the circle, there is a section with a coat of arms and some text.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot after Andrea del Sarto
artworks.description: The image is a detailed etching depicting a group of four people within a circular frame. The figures are shown from the waist up. In the center, there is a young woman sitting, looking slightly to her right. She has delicate facial features and is wearing a headscarf. Next to her, two small, curly-haired children are present, with one child sitting on the lap of the seated woman. The child on her lap is facing to the side, and the other child is standing while facing forward. On the far left, an elderly man with a beard appears to be leaning forward, partially included in the frame. The figures are draped in cloth garments. The background consists of intricate linework and a round, decorative border enclosing the group. Below the circular illustration, there is text and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Angels
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a seated woman with a child on her lap, surrounded by three angels and a bearded man. The woman's full body is depicted, sitting on a draped surface, with the child sitting up and being embraced. The woman has long hair covered by a cloth that extends down her back. The child appears to have curly hair. The woman is draped in flowing garments that cover her body, and the child is depicted nude. The man's face is partially turned away, showing a prominent nose and curly beard. He is clothed in a draped garment as well. One angel shows only their head and wings, while the other two angels show full bodies, identifiable by their wings, and are playing musical instruments—one plays a stringed instrument while the other a woodwind. There is no prominent jewelry in the scene. The background consists of vertical lines and includes an elaborately draped fabric at the top.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: The image shows a shirtless man standing in the center wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth around his waist. On his sides are men in robes, with one gesturing towards him. A crowd of people in historical clothing is gathered in the foreground below, looking upward. The background features columns, clouds in the sky, and a distant cityscape.

artworks.title: Painting of the Annunciation

A group of people are gathered below a slightly elevated area where an angel is speaking to a seated figure. The figures below are engaged in various activities, some gesturing towards the elevated scene while others observe with interest. The architectural details include windows, columns, and a draped cloth. A small dog is seen in the foreground. The text at the bottom indicates it may be an illustrated narrative related to religious or historical storytelling.

artworks.title: The Child

The baby is in an ornate cradle with a protective figure above it. The background includes curtains and fabric folds. In the top right corner, there is a scene with a haloed figure seated on a cloud, with another figure kneeling in front. An Italian inscription is visible at the bottom of the image.
